scope: Two single-assertion changes, each approved on its own. (1) apps/screamingface-engine/tests/unit/test_chart_render_world_config.py, test_one_source_reaches_both_pods_identically: the assertion that URL4_RUNNER_CONFIG is the mount path plus '/url4.toml' becomes two assertions, that it equals the mount path and that the mount's subPath is 'url4.toml'. (2) apps/screamingface-engine/tests/unit/test_route_publication.py, test_metrics_label_a_private_mount_without_its_path: the assertion that POST on a private mount is counted as path="<private>" with status 405 becomes path="<unmatched>" with status 404. Every other change to these two files is an appended test; each file is listed only because this approval pins its whole content. No other edits.
reason: The second review of PR #1606 found that a running pod saw its live-updated world config change, and that a private mount answered an ungranted caller differently from a route the Engine never declared. On 2026-10-29 the owner chose to mount the world file by subPath, so a pod keeps the file it started with, and to answer every refusal of a private mount to a caller without a proven grant as the framework's 404 for an undeclared path, counted as <unmatched>. The two old assertions pinned the directory mount and the 405 answer.
